messages:
maya: Heads-up — we're kicking off on-prem private VPC commissioning for GovCorp APAC site next week. Air-gapped, limited rack PDUs, 4x A10G per rack, and customer requires no direct internet egress. Need final runbook (bootstrap, validation, handoff) and quick list of gotchas (GPU firmware, MTU, seed images). Who can own validation checklist?
liam: I can own validation. Quick priorities: 1) Check power budget per PDU + GPU draw (A10G ~300W peak) 2) Verify boot images via checksum before flashing 3) Network: MTU 9000 across TORs, BGP neighbor slated, but confirm route filters 4) NTP + internal DNS only 5) Kernel + driver matrix (we need CUDA 12.1 compatible).
omar: Re: drivers — confirm host kernel <= 5.15 is compatible with our runtime image. If customer has RHEL8.8 or similar, plan for DKMS or prebuilt driver bundle. Also request customer provide serial console access for first-boot logs.
devex-julie: For canary plan: spin up 2 nodes behind a test route, seed with 10% traffic via traffic-splitting policy, run per-route latency checks for 30 mins, then promote. I have a harness script. Snippet: ```
# run from admin jump
./canary-run.sh --nodes node02,node03 --traffic 10% --duration 1800
kubectl --context=private get pods -n redwood-serving
```
liam: Air-gap transfer: use dual-USB with checksum verification; commands we use: `sha256sum redwood-runtime.tar.gz` on laptop and target, then `dd if=/dev/sdb of=/tmp/image.tar bs=4M status=progress` — label media with build id. Also push seed manifests via local registry on the bastion.
ops-lin: Customer networking notes: their firewall only allows specific outbound IPs later for telemetry; for initial work we need temporary ACL to allow registry pull or else use air-gapped registry. Also double-check their proxy intercepts TLS — we've seen mTLS termination break image pulls.
sre-bot: Ticket auto-created: INFRA-1227 — "GovCorp APAC private VPC commissioning" assigned to @liam, priority P1. Please update with acceptance checklist.
omar: GPU health quick checks after boot: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,serial,fb_memory_total --format=csv` expect no ECC errors; sample: "A100-SXM4, GPU-123456, 40960 MiB". If ECC errors >0 run memtest on card.
liam: Validation checklist (short): - Power & PDU mapping verified - Images SHA256 verified - Kernel/driver matrix ok - MTU + BGP routes validated - NTP + DNS reachable - Local registry seeded - Canary pass (latency/percentiles) - Logging/metrics ingestion to customer's splunk (or alternative) - Handoff doc + runbook link created
devex-julie: I'll prepare the handoff doc template and a condensed "on-call playbook" (30 lines) for their SRE. Also will attach our perf baseline for A10G at 2k token/min tests.
ops-lin: Cost/ops note: If they want reserved capacity with Dedicated later, pricing estimate assumes 3 racks baseline. Logging retention and egress to our hosted console (if enabled) will add monthly ~USD 1.2k for 30d retention at current rates — flag to sales.
maya: Thanks everyone — @liam please paste the final checklist and I'll schedule the dry-run this Friday with customer's infra lead. Add any runbook links in the ticket. :thumbsup:
